note: First split. Act I (floors 1-15) is the linear trunk; the tower branches from the Lazarus wipe onward. All three branches are 4 hops with a code requirement, deriving D4 — route choice changes the skill demanded, never the difficulty.

branches.narrative: Plant rooms and maintenance ducts between the trading floors. Sentinel Shield's physical layer is documented nowhere except in contractor snag lists and forty thousand pages of commissioning paperwork.
The directors' lift bank and the meetings it carries. Everyone in the minutes has a reason to shade the record, and two of them are lying about the same afternoon.
Cold storage for everything Meridian was required to keep and would rather forget. The index was corrupted in 2019 and never rebuilt; what remains is recoverable only by reading the format itself.
